title: Lothlórien and the Breaking of the Fellowship
range: Lothlórien and the Breaking of the Fellowship

questions.question: Who is the Lady of the Golden Wood of Lothlórien?
questions.note: She is tested by the Ring and refuses it. 'I pass the test.'

questions.question: In what does Galadriel show Frodo visions of what may come?
questions.answer: Her mirror, a basin of water
choices: Her mirror, a basin of water
questions.note: He sees the Shire burned and enslaved if the quest fails.

questions.question: What does Galadriel give Frodo as a light in dark places?
questions.answer: A phial holding the light of Eärendil
choices: A phial holding the light of Eärendil
A torch that never goes out
questions.note: 'May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out.'

questions.question: What Elvish waybread can fill a man with one bite?
questions.note: Merry and Pippin eat four each. Sam later runs low.

questions.question: What giant stone statues of kings guard the river Anduin?
questions.note: Aragorn has long wanted to see them: Isildur and Anárion.

questions.question: Who tries to take the Ring from Frodo at Amon Hen?
questions.note: He repents, and dies defending Merry and Pippin.

questions.question: What kind of Orc, bred by Saruman, kills Boromir?
questions.note: Their leader shoots him with three arrows.

questions.question: Which two hobbits are carried off by the Uruk-hai?
questions.note: Saruman has ordered them to bring back hobbits alive.

questions.question: Who goes with Frodo when he sets out alone for Mordor?
questions.note: Sam wades in after the boat even though he cannot swim. Frodo pulls him in.

questions.question: What does Aragorn swear to the dying Boromir he will not let fall?
